prompts: Create ONE animation contact sheet, exactly TWO columns by FOUR rows = EIGHT consecutive frames in reading order, no gutters, no panel borders, no labels. Canvas 1280x1440, each panel 640x360 16:9. Strict 1990s CPS2/Neo Geo PIXEL ART at native resolution: crisp stepped pixel clusters, bold dark contours, flat 2-3 tone shading, muted restrained colors, same limited palette in all frames. NOT smooth illustration, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradients, no text, no watermarks. Every panel is a fully opaque finished cinematic frame. Coherent same subjects and background, small incremental motion from frame to frame. Do not change camera unless requested. OPENING C1, four-second loop. Seoul night skyline, empty city, deep navy-purple sky over layered low rooftop silhouettes, far grey towers and closer rooftops. Eight temporal frames: near roof layer slides slowly LEFT, middle towers slide left more slowly, far skyline almost fixed. A few large rectangular windows blink softly warm amber. Preserve city architecture precisely through motion. No people, no vehicles, no signage, no stars shaped like letters. Wide atmospheric panorama, quiet uncanny mood.
